about.text: A soft white cheese of the Middle East, popular around the Persian Gulf, with a mild taste like feta but less salty; originally from Bedouin goat or sheep milk, now mostly cow milk.

Infobox: no ageing; semi-soft, rubbery, creamy; also sold dried and salted; Turkish version traditionally goat milk; rennet assumed, not stated

facts.v: A similar fresh basket-shaped curd cheese on Turkey's Aegean coast; seaside versions are called kelle cheese. Whether it is the same cheese is not settled
